info.name: Petyard assistant checkout summary
info.description: Authenticated default-off read-only commerce estimate. Requires the current effective warehouse. Uses cart rate admission. No coupon application or ordering. See AI_ASSISTANT_CHECKOUT_CONTRACT.md.

request.description: Supply the current resolve-location effective warehouse, never zoneWarehouse. Unknown shipping/total remain null. Returned action opens existing app checkout/cart; refresh live data there.

exec: pm.test("Estimate only", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.dataMode).to.eql("estimate"); pm.expect(d.requiresCheckoutRefresh).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Ask checkout estimate in chat (manual opt-in)

request.description: Manual future use only: a running worker may dispatch a billable model call. Leave messageKey blank to prevent dispatch. Use one unique key per logical message; keep it unchanged with the identical body for retries. Requires approved enabled test configuration, authenticated token and effective warehouse. No live execution was performed for this contract.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('messageKey')) throw new Error('Set an explicit messageKey only for an approved manual chat request.');

request.description: Use the admitted data.run.id. Wait pollAfterMs between manual polls while queued/dispatching; no continuous GET checkout-summary loop. Completed data.message.checkout is optional and historical.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('runId')) throw new Error('Supply the admitted runId.');

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const c = pm.response.json().data.message?.checkout; if (c) pm.test('Estimate requires checkout refresh', () => { pm.expect(c.dataMode).to.eql('estimate'); pm.expect(c.requiresCheckoutRefresh).to.eql(true); }); }

request.description: Existing newest-first history with optional message.checkout. Does not reread cart. Clear local wallet/card data at logout/account switch; compare current area before navigation.
